title: BlobSyncer
description: BlobSyncer.Azure.BlobStorage is a tool designed to download files from Azure Blob Storage and store them in the filesystem. It is structured to support additional syncing features in the future, allowing files to be synced to another Blob Storage using DestinationHandlers.
